# apple_profile (Data Source)

Looks up a provisioning profile by its App Store Connect ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_profile" "app_store" {
  name = "Example App Store"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the profile. Set this or `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the profile. Set this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `bundle_id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the profile's bundle ID.
- `certificate_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the profile's certificates.
- `created_date` (String) Creation date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `device_ids` (Set of String) App Store Connect IDs of the profile's devices.
- `expiration_date` (String) Expiration date, in RFC 3339 format.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the profile.
- `profile_content` (String, Sensitive) The profile, base64-encoded.
- `profile_state` (String) State: `ACTIVE` or `INVALID`.
- `profile_type` (String) Profile type.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the profile.
